allowed_sessions.description: Explicit group UMO allowlist; native whitelist is also required.

classifier_provider_id.description: Explicit configured classifier provider. Enabled use makes bounded paid requests; tests mock it.

probe_interval_seconds.description: Minimum classification gap per group (5-120 seconds).

probes_per_hour.description: Per-group hourly calls (1-120); global hard cap 120/hour.

max_sessions.description: LRU session cache limit (1-256); idle eviction after 30 minutes.
